normative_statement: A full token MUST be encoded as prefix:jwt-token.
rationale: The prefix is outside the JWT and selects the cypher configuration

normative_statement: The verifier MUST treat the text after the final colon as the JWT token and the text before it as the prefix.
rationale: This permits prefixes that themselves contain colons

normative_statement: verifyId MUST reject a token whose extracted prefix is empty or unsupported.
rationale: A token cannot be safely verified without a known cypher

normative_statement: verifyIdByPrefix MUST reject a full token whose embedded prefix differs from the requested prefix.
rationale: Callers cannot accidentally verify a token under a different namespace

normative_statement: The protocol MUST be described as signing rather than encryption because JWT payload fields are visible.
rationale: Prevents callers from storing secrets in the payload

normative_statement: Signing MUST validate the ID payload before creating a JWT.
rationale: Invalid payloads should fail before any cryptographic operation

normative_statement: Signing MUST add a relative expiration claim to the JWT.
rationale: Verified tokens need a bounded lifetime

normative_statement: When expectedScope is configured every expected key MUST match the decoded scope value.
rationale: The configured scope is a mandatory subset rather than a full equality check

normative_statement: When a custom scope validator is configured the decoded payload MUST include scope and the validator MUST return true.
rationale: Allows language implementations to attach local policy

normative_statement: Verification MUST first try the current secret.
rationale: Normal traffic should use the active secret

normative_statement: Verification MAY try altSecret only after current-secret verification fails.
rationale: Supports secret rotation without masking current-secret success

normative_statement: Successful verification MUST return the ID payload without exposing exp as an application field.
rationale: Expiration is a protocol claim rather than part of the domain payload

normative_statement: Operations MUST return structured failure results instead of throwing for expected validation and verification failures.
